$comment: Ported from GitHub Light Default and GitHub Dark Default, github.com/primer/github-vscode-theme (MIT, Copyright (c) 2020 Primer), as published in Shiki's bundled themes.
name: GitHub
author: GitHub, ported for Switchboard

$comment: From github-light-default.json: canvas is editor.background, accent is focusBorder (the Primer accent).
code-bg is editor.background: the comments (#6e7781) fall under AA on textCodeBlock.background (#afb8c133).
warn ("needs you") is Primer's pink #bf3989, from the theme's palette: the theme has no colour for that state, and its attention yellow would read as "working" here.
caution is gitDecoration.conflictingResourceForeground (Primer severe, orange); unread is the link blue.
From github-dark-default.json: canvas is editor.background, accent is focusBorder (the Primer accent).
code-bg is editor.background: the comments (#8b949e) fall under AA on textCodeBlock.background (#6e768166).
warn ("needs you") is Primer's pink #ff9bce, from the theme's palette: the theme has no colour for that state, and its attention yellow would read as "working" here.
caution is gitDecoration.conflictingResourceForeground (Primer severe, orange); unread is the link blue.
